# Sago Techz

> Sago Techz Pvt. Ltd. builds AI-powered software, Generative AI and RAG applications, business automation, web platforms and custom digital solutions for businesses across Tamil Nadu and India. Ideas → Code → Impact.

Sago Techz is a small, engineering-led team that works remotely with clients across Tamil Nadu (including Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, Tiruchirappalli, Salem and Tiruppur), elsewhere in India and abroad.

## Services

- AI & Generative AI development: AI assistants, AI agents, LLM integrations, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and custom GenAI solutions.
- Custom software development: web and mobile applications, SaaS platforms, internal tools and APIs.
- Business automation & RPA: workflow automation, system-to-system integrations and human-in-the-loop approvals.
- AI call quality analysis: transcription, quality scorecards, sentiment and compliance signals for customer conversations.
- Meeting intelligence: transcripts, summaries, decisions and action items from meetings.
- Cloud & integrations: cloud architecture, deployment, third-party API integrations and monitoring.

## Technology

Python, FastAPI, Django, React, Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, OpenAI and other LLMs, vector databases.

## How we work

Discover → Design → Build → Test → Launch → Grow.
